prompt: Which listed contract can perform the desired operation by itself? Choose none if no single listed contract can.

labels.inspect: Read one named text source and return its resource reference, revision, line count, and digest; do not produce a report
labels.assemble: Assemble supplied inspection results into a report with the source read set; do not write an external destination
labels.publish: Conditionally write an already checked report to an existing destination and return a publication receipt
labels.normalize: Collapse whitespace in one supplied text value and return the normalized text
labels.fold: Combine inspection digests into one canonical fold digest
labels.none: No single listed contract performs the requested operation
